It can be obtained through the use of the [[Divine Font]] in the [[Lord's Labyrinth]]. |is_drop_restricted = true |release_version = 3.29.0 }} '''Divine Blast of Radiance''' is a [[shield]] skill that projects holy energy at the target location, creating an implosion that deals [[Physical damage|physical]] and [[fire damage]] in an [[area]]. It then creates an [[Orb skill|orb]] for a [[duration]], periodically dealing damage again in a larger area with the explosion frequency scaling with [[attack speed]]. The damage from this skill scales with the shield's [[defense]] values. It is a [[transfigured]] version of {{il|Divine Blast}}. __TOC__ ==Changes from default version== Unlike the original skill, this transfigured version creates an orb that deals damage over a duration, instead of a single delayed explosion.
